Clients Scope of Work Description:

Preparatory Work (Client scope of work):

Civil work requirements 1. All minor builder work related to the installation of the elevator. 2. Enclosed & Lockable area near the hoist way for storage of
material to be provided as per our requirement. 3. Provide us with finished and dry hoist way, machine room, pit and complete the preparatory work as per the
norms laid out in the Indian Standards 14665:2000. 4. The lobby architrave would need to be carried out on our completing the entrances. Also, after
installation of doors, adequate measures would need to be taken to protect the landing doors and landing fixtures from damage and breakage during the
architrave work. 5. Adequate measures need to be taken to prevent water from seeping into the hoist way. 6. Adequate ventilation for Head room with rain
protected windows or Louvers. Temperature of machine area not to exceed 45°C 7. White washing and plastering of elevator hoist way before start of
installation. 8. Making of buffer blocks in lift pit. 9. Providing lintels as per our requirement as specified in the layout at each landing. 10. Necessary hoisting
beams/hooks need to be provided. 11. Where ever required Machine pedestal or I-Beams to be provided according to our instructions. 12. Hoistway size should
be as per our required size and if not separator beams to be provided and fixed as per our engineer's instructions. partition and recession from shaft top slab to
the pit floor 13. Supply & Fixing of Pit Ladder 14. Only Alpha Elevators or Alpha Elevators authorized personnel shall remove the barricades 15. Fascias for flush
hoist way walls free of setbacks or projections. 16. Full height fascia to be provided were the distance between car sill to front wall shaft inside is more than 135
mm Electrical work requirements.

Taxes & Duties
are levied by the government on the product time to time.. The Supply Installation & Commissioning of the elevator at your site will be a
single sales contract of the elevator. Any increase in the present taxation structure or introduction of additional taxes by the State or Central Authorities
will be borne by you. If any levy, taxes, duties, or octroi, applicable at the time of accepting this work order is revised, reviewed, renamed, modified in any
manner whatsoever till the time of execution and completion of work order, then the increase will be exclusively borne by you.

Validity:
This offer is not subject to any variation and is firm and valid for your acceptance within 7 days of this offer date. On acceptance of the offer, the
contract is valid for Handover after completion of Installation. Price validity will be for 18 months from the date of contract and Hand over validity will be 18
month from the date of contract. After the price validity date, the price & delivery terms must be renegotiated.

Dispatch and Installation:
Delivery of material shall be 120 working days from the release for ordering of materials, approval of layout, technical specification,
and full compliance of contractual payment terms whichever is later. Installation of each unit shall be completed in 20 to 30 working days from the date of
start of Installation work at site, provided all our requests mentioned in the preparatory work are adhered to and contractual terms complied.

Warranty & Maintenance : Your Elevator comes with lifetime warranty for motor & 05 Years warranty against any manufacturing defect, 5 years battery warranty (3 years replaceable and 2 years service). We also Provide 1 years free service from the date of installation or 60 days from the date of delivery, whichever is earlier. We will provide 2 routine services in a year. From 2nd year onwards there will be option for Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) Comprehensive AMC 5% of the Basic Cost: Routine maintenance service and Complaints will be attended wherein the parts are also covered. - Applicable after 5 years Non-comprehensive AMC 3% of the Basic Cost: Routine maintenance service will be carried out and complaints will be attended, but any part that needs replacement will be charged. - Applicable after 1 years On-Call Basis Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) - a convenient and cost-effective solution for all your maintenance needs. For just ₹7,000 per standard visit and ₹5,000 per emergency visit, our certified technicians provide top-notch service, ensuring your equipment and systems remain in optimal condition - Applicable after 1 years.
